notes.purpose: T15: SpringBoard-only XPCCompilerConnection lifetime trace. Capture construction, reply status, enqueue, invoke before/after xpc_release, destruction and pre-delete. Object and pointees are raw candidates; freed memory is not typed.
notes.images: AGXCompilerConnection at unslid 0x1851bc000 and AGXGLDriver at 0x180260000 are present in the cache's own image table but absent from cache-index.json images. Hook installation uses the index mappings and verifies the actual cache instruction bytes.
notes.limits: Use --max-hits sb_compiler_=128 and check counts for saturation. These focused hooks avoid the global dispatch_release breakpoint. No guest memory/register writes.
